name: glb-designer-stage6b
description: Asset Studio Iteration 2 Stage 6b — geometry ops II in the GLB Asset Designer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Add a Box and dial its 'Hollow (wall)' slider so it becomes an open-top carcass, then look straight down (Top view) to confirm the open cavity + uniform wall thickness. Add a Loft (round → square by default) and shape it into a tapered vase, confirming no twisted/inverted faces. Add a Sweep, switch its path to Custom and feed an S-curve so the rail follows the drawn path smoothly. Finally Save and assert the persisted UserGltfDef's assetSpec (v8 envelope) embeds the box shell, the loft's bottom+top cross-sections, and the sweep's custom path points — the whole geometry layer round-trips as an editable spec.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: shape-box
steps.comment: A shallow tray-like box 0.5 x 0.3 x 0.5 raised so its whole cavity is visible.
steps.eval: (function(){ const set = (label, val) => { const inp = document.querySelector(`.glb-designer input[aria-label="${label}"]`); if (!inp) throw new Error('missing input: ' + label); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, String(val)); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; set('box size X', 0.5); set('box size Y', 0.3); set('box size Z', 0.5); set('box position Y', 0.15); })()

steps.name: set-hollow
steps.comment: Dial the Hollow (wall) slider so the box becomes an open-top carcass with 3 cm walls.
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector(".glb-designer input[aria-label='box hollow wall']"); if (!inp) throw new Error('box hollow wall slider missing'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, '0.03'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: assert-hollow
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const box = s.parts.find(p => p.kind === 'box'); if (!box) throw new Error('box missing'); if (!(box.shell > 0.02 && box.shell < 0.04)) throw new Error('box shell not set (~0.03), got ' + box.shell); })()

steps.name: top-view
steps.comment: Look straight down so the open cavity + uniform wall thickness read clearly.

steps.name: add-loft
steps.comment: A Loft seeds a round-bottom → square-top body by default.

steps.name: shape-loft
steps.comment: Make it a taller vase (0.3 x 0.55 x 0.3) offset to +X, clear of the box.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); const loft = s.parts.find(p => p.kind === 'loft'); if (!loft) throw new Error('loft part missing'); loft.size = [0.3, 0.55, 0.3]; loft.position = [0.8, 0.275, 0]; loft.color = '#7a9bb0'; window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); })()

steps.name: assert-loft
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const loft = s.parts.find(p => p.kind === 'loft'); if (!loft) throw new Error('loft missing'); if (!Array.isArray(loft.loftBottom) || loft.loftBottom.length < 3) throw new Error('loft bottom section missing'); if (!Array.isArray(loft.loftTop) || loft.loftTop.length < 3) throw new Error('loft top section missing'); })()

steps.name: make-custom-rail
steps.comment: Switch the sweep path to Custom and feed an S-curve drawn in the top-view path editor, offset to +X.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); const sweep = s.parts.find(p => p.kind === 'sweep'); if (!sweep) throw new Error('sweep part missing'); sweep.sweepProfile = 'circle'; sweep.sweepPath = 'custom'; sweep.sweepPathPoints = [[-0.5,-0.4],[-0.2,-0.5],[0,0],[0.2,0.5],[0.5,0.4]]; sweep.size = [0.7, 0.05, 0.7]; sweep.position = [1.5, 0.2, 0]; sweep.color = '#b5793a'; window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); })()

steps.name: assert-rail
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const sweep = s.parts.find(p => p.kind === 'sweep'); if (!sweep) throw new Error('sweep missing'); if (sweep.sweepPath !== 'custom') throw new Error('sweep path not custom'); if (!Array.isArray(sweep.sweepPathPoints) || sweep.sweepPathPoints.length < 4) throw new Error('custom sweep path points missing'); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage6b Geometry'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-geometry-ops
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved assetSpec (v8+ envelope — the geometry layer landed at v8 and rides forward through later envelope bumps) embeds the box shell, the loft's bottom+top cross-sections, and the sweep's custom path points — the Stage-6b geometry layer round-trips as an editable spec.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage6b Geometry' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && d.assetSpec.includes('"kind":"asset"') && (() => { try { const env = JSON.parse(d.assetSpec); if (!(env.v >= 8)) return false; const s = env.payload; const box = s.parts.find(p => p.kind === 'box'); const loft = s.parts.find(p => p.kind === 'loft'); const sweep = s.parts.find(p => p.kind === 'sweep'); return box && box.shell > 0 && loft && Array.isArray(loft.loftBottom) && Array.isArray(loft.loftTop) && sweep && sweep.sweepPath === 'custom' && Array.isArray(sweep.sweepPathPoints) && sweep.sweepPathPoints.length >= 4; } catch { return false } })())

steps.failMessage: saved assetSpec should embed the box shell, the loft cross-sections, and the custom sweep path (v8+ envelope)
